summary: Identiv, Inc. (now renamed INVE Technologies, Inc.) completed the sale of its specialty Internet of Things business to Trackonomy Systems, Inc. on September 15, 2026, under a Stock and Asset Purchase Agreement dated June 24, 2026. The company sold substantially all operating assets, all shares of Identiv (Thailand) Co., Ltd., and $25 million cash, while the buyer assumed related liabilities. Consideration was $50 million of Trackonomy Series C Preferred Stock at $20.07 per share. The board approved the name change on September 11, 2026. Watch post-closing adjustment disputes and the illiquid preferred stake's valuation.
